overview: Love Takes A Village will see singletons go on a series of blind dates with people looking to win a second date. While the two people on the date know they're on a dating show, what they don't know is that the date, which they think is at a restaurant, is actually taking place inside a studio with a live audience watching in secret. At the end of the date, the couple find out who's been watching them.
title: Love Takes A Village

overview: Featuring conversations with newsmakers from across politics, business, culture and sports, The Will Cain Show will offer a comprehensive look at the news of the day in a signature podcast style.
title: The Will Cain Show

overview: Join FOX & Friends Weekend host Will Cain as he tackles the latest headlines from his unique perspective along with thought-provoking long-form interviews with leading figures and live calls from viewers and listeners. The Will Cain Show merges the worlds of news and sports, with a spotlight on audience interaction.
title: Will Cain Country

overview: Confessions of Octomom follows Suleman as she provides an intimate look at her history and her life today as a mom of 14, and her newest role as a grandmother. With her octuplets turning sixteen this January and her other six children ranging from 17 to 23 years-old, Suleman has been out of the public eye for years and now, for the first time, Suleman and her 14 children reveal a much different life than the world has ever been privy to before. The series also follows the octuplets through their challenges and triumphs, growing up in the spotlight and their desire to move beyond their now secluded life.
title: Confessions of Octomom

overview: Joe Roman has come by his self-reliance naturally. His parents divorced when he was little, and his dad"a race car driver"remarried and focused primarily on his new family with his young wife Claire. Joe spent his childhood on the move with his mother, venturing out on his own when he was just 15. A year after his father's fatal accident, Joe returns to Philadelphia to collect his share of his Dad's estate, a car customizing business. His reunion with Claire and his half brothers is a little rocky. Despite her best efforts, Claire is struggling to keep the business afloat. Fifteen-year-old Matt, tormented by a number of teen crises both real and imagined, harbors a lot of resentment toward Joe. And Andy, a wildly imaginative seven-year-old, can't quite hide his need for a father figure. It doesn't take long for Joe to realize how much he's needed, so he accepts Claire's offer to move in and work in the family business.
title: Brotherly Love

overview: Trial & Error: Why Did O.J. Win? will explore what went right for the defense, what went wrong for the prosecution and the perfect storm of legal strategies and surprises that led to one of the most controversial verdicts in history. The series highlights myriad vantage points from numerous trial participants, including attorneys, legal experts, Los Angeles police detectives and friends and relatives on both sides of the courtroom.
title: Trial & Error: Why Did O.J. Win?

overview: Cóyotl, Héroe y Bestia tells the story of a Mexican hero who will fight to defend his own and become the guardian that his people need, starting an epic fight between good and evil.
title: Cóyotl, Héroe y Bestia

overview: Once the golden boys of the monarchy, brothers William and Harry are now at war. This two-part series delves deep into their now-fractured relationship, revealing just when those battle lines were drawn.
title: William & Harry: Love & Betrayal

overview: On creativity, life and scandals: the most candid music podcast, in which the leader of the band "Hammerman Destroys Viruses" Albert Tsukrenko asks his guests unexpected provocative questions.
title: СучЦукрМуз

overview: What can drive someone to murder their partner? When does everything go wrong, and why? "In Death and Lust" examines the determining factors behind how a loving relationship can end in murder.
title: I död och lust

overview: What happens when six opinionated Brits with starkly opposed views on immigration confront the harsh realities of refugee life? Dave, a chef from Nottingham; Bushra, a small business owner from Surrey; Chloe, a GB News regular from Cornwall; Nathan, a haulage business owner from Barnsley; Mathilda, a podcaster from London; and Jess, a sports coach from Wales, put their outspoken views on immigration to the ultimate test on a life-changing journey. In Mogadishu in Somalia and Raqqa in Syria, two of the world's most dangerous cities, they're exposed to a life of missile strikes, overcrowded refugee camps, and the crippling poverty endured by millions. Often hiding behind humour, their deeply polarized views on immigration are pushed to breaking point, sparking intense conflicts and shocking revelations. Through Africa, the Middle East and Europe, heading back to the UK, they cross vast deserts, climb treacherous mountain borders, and endure some of the peril of small boat crossings as they uncover the raw truth of how refugees reach Britain, why they risk everything to get here, and what they leave behind. Will this eye-opening journey change their minds on immigration, or will it only strengthen their resolve?
title: Go Back To Where You Came From

overview: In this brand-new series, George Clarke meets people who are taking on challenging huge builds for powerful emotional reasons, from being drawn back to an area that they've always loved or a place with strong family memories, to taking on a house that's close to their heart - like historic ruins that need rescuing, or a wreck of a beach house. We follow them as they uproot their lives, stretch their finances and test their relationships, all in order to build wonderful homes of their dreams.
title: George Clarke's Building Home

overview: This new reality series is set in a leading Dubai real estate company - where agents chase riches in one of the hottest luxury property markets in the world. A cast of ambitious agents tour some of the city's most jaw-dropping properties, deploying their charm and business savvy to sell to the super-rich as they compete for eye-watering commissions - often £100k for just one sale, all tax-free.
title: Dubai: Buying The Dream

overview: In the 80s, a brilliant university student, Lu Ran, was forced into marriage for money by her uncle and aunt to a rough, poor man with a child! Refusing to let others decide her fate, Lu Ran daringly escapes. But during her escape, she unexpectedly encounters a tall, handsome, and gentle man—who turns out to be her real fiancé?!
title: Spring Burning

overview: The Single Guy features struggling New York City writer Jonathan Eliot, and follows several of his close friends Also includes Eliot's best friend Sam Sloan, Sam's wife Trudy and doorman Manny throughout its entire run.
title: The Single Guy

overview: A limited series inspired by the story of how Amanda Knox was wrongfully convicted for the tragic murder of her roommate, Meredith Kercher, and her 16-year odyssey to set herself free.
title: The Twisted Tale of Amanda Knox

overview: In the working-class neighborhoods of the South of France, four women with quite different profiles and in financial difficulty realize that it is not so complicated to rob a bank. They will quickly find themselves in a vicious cycle...
title: Les Lionnes

overview: Johan, a border police officer in Helsingborg, dreams of a promotion, ideally to the FBI. When Rasmus, his unassuming counterpart in Helsingør, reports an armed man boarding the ferry to Sweden, Johan sees his big break. Rasmus, eager to end his shift and propose to his girlfriend, reluctantly joins Johan in pursuit. As they chase the gunman, they stumble upon what could be the corruption scandal of the century. With two mismatched cops and high stakes, what could possibly go wrong?
title: Gränsfall

overview: In this new heart-stopping police series, we follow one of Britain's top homicide teams as a series of horrific and violent murder investigations unfold. With extraordinary access throughout each case, the series draws the viewer into the dark heart of murder investigations as the hours and minutes tick away. Can the detectives unravel what happened and who was responsible, will the police manage to confront their Murder Suspect No.1 in interview and present their evidence? And will they get the charges to stick before the suspect strikes again?
title: Murder: Suspect No 1

overview: Meet the underdogs! They might be rescued, abandoned or just plain unruly, but these imperfect pooches all have one thing in common: they need a new purpose in life. Hosted by Alan Titchmarsh, our underdogs will be trained by experts to do incredible jobs. Each has a vision for what these dogs could achieve; from finding people lost in the wilderness, to rescuing from water, or a film stunt dog. We join them for the highs and lows of the training process, but time is ticking... Each of them must undergo a final challenge. Will these underdogs have it in them to become superdogs?
title: Alan Titchmarsh's Underdog to Superdog

overview: Nehir is a lawyer who takes a break from her career to care for her children. Her seemingly happy marriage with her husband, Serdar, takes an unexpected turn when Serdar suddenly disappears.
title: Başka Bir Gün

overview: Uprising is set to showcase some of the finest talents on the Irish music scene right now. Filmed at The Complex in Dublin's North inner-city, there'll be performances from bright new talents and established stars alike, as well as topical discussions, outspoken opinions – and, of course, lots of fun.
title: Uprising

overview: A family-friendly, early WB sitcom that chronicles the ups and downs of parenting and family life as experienced by a professor and his wife as they raise their four kids. The series, produced by star Robert Townsend, sometimes tackles tough issues such as single motherhood, gangs, guns and dropping out of school.
title: The Parent 'Hood

overview: The stories of our civilization passed down from generation to generation are in the documentary "Those Who Remain for the Future"!
title: Geleceğe Kalanlar

overview: At the border between Jinglan and the Manchu Changmo, there is a frontier fortress called Tianlang Pass. General Xiao Chi, renowned as the "White Horse God of War," is at his subordinate's wedding banquet when he is caught trying to sneak a drink by his guards and the army cook, who forces him to drink drugs. Amid the jeers of the crowd and his pleas for mercy, the bride, Han Yunling, arrives in a red veil to perform the wedding ceremony, and he obstructs her final bow. Just then, someone reports that the bride has been forced into marriage. He swiftly dismisses the groom and imprisons him, then personally interrogates the bride. Upon seeing the bride, he immediately recognizes her as the girl who had stopped him from committing suicide and saved him as a child. He is overjoyed at their reunion but does not express it immediately. After thorough investigation, he learns that she has been forced to marry her subordinate to save her wrongly imprisoned friend Jiang Wanyu. He has Wanyu brought to him and releases the two women. Yunling returns as she does not want to owe him a favor, and she could also tell at a glance that he is critically ill and requires immediate treatment. He begs her not to reveal his condition so as not to cause panic, but she claims that she can cure his illness…
title: You Are a Lover in the Mortal World

overview: Chen Xiaohua, a good-for-nothing emperor, transforms from self-abandonment to taking responsibility with the help of his android consort, 2099. But it turns out all this happens in a virtual world. In the real world, Chen Xiaohua is on the brink of brain death. To help him awaken, Jiang Tao sacrifices her life to help Chen Xiaohua complete the turnaround mission. After he wakes up, facing his comatose girlfriend, it's his turn to save her.
MasterChef's Simon Toohey presents a mix of his unique recipes in his own kitchen, featuring some of Australia's fresh produce producers.
title: Freshly Picked with Simon Toohey

overview: Start your day with live, breaking news from Canada and around the world. Heather Hiscox is in the anchor chair as host, bringing her unique perspective as one of Canada's most experienced and tenacious journalists to CBC News Network.
title: CBC Morning Live with Heather Hiscox

overview: Reading Rainbow is an American children's television series aired by PBS from June 6, 1983 until November 10, 2006 that encouraged reading among children. The award-winning public television series garnered over 200 broadcast awards, including scores of Emmy Awards, many for "Outstanding Children's Series". The series was created under the leadership of Cecily Truett Lancit and Larry Lancit, at Lancit Media Productions in New York. The concept of a reading series for children was inspired by Twila Liggett, Ph.D., of Lincoln, Nebraska of the Great Plains National Instructional Television Library at the University of Nebraska–Lincoln; Paul Schupbach, director of the Great Plains National Instructional Television LIbrary; and Tony Buttino, of WNED-TV Buffalo, New York. The original team included Lynne Brenner Ganek, Ellen Schecter, and LeVar Burton as host.
title: Reading Rainbow

overview: The series tells the story of a final-year student in the Turkish Language Department who enters the world of the mafia and changes everything, and whose paths intersect with journalist Sahar at university.
title: Bir Zamanlar İstanbul

overview: Based in Bundaberg Queensland Australia, the team at Exploring Off the Grid love nothing more than hitting the road, tracks and water in search of Australia's idyllic places, we will travel far and wide to find old relics, wartime plane crashes, old huts and machinery. In doing so we get to see some amazing places, meet some awesome people and experience some true Australian characters. Whether it be Cape York, Tasmania, the Kimberley or anywhere in between join us on the adventure!
title: Exploring Off The Grid

overview: Get ready for tasty recipes that don't break the bank!
title: Frugal Foodie

overview: An Australian Road Trip Series where we discover those hidden gems that only the local know about. We tour on some of the lesser known Roads throughout Australia.
title: Roads Less Travelled

overview: For more than 40 years, a secret unit of undercover police were paid to spy on ordinary members of the public. Shockingly, they included more than 60 women – deceived into deeply intimate relationships with officers who they had no idea were deployed in covert operations. The ‘spycops scandal' is the subject of an almost decade-long £88 million public inquiry into their tactics and now, a gripping three-part documentary series for ITV1 and ITVX, The Undercover Police Scandal: Love and Lies Exposed, which will air in early 2025. Five of the women who were deceived and blew the lid off this scandal, have entrusted ITV, makers of the award-winning drama series Mr Bates vs The Post Office, to expose how they turned detective to uncover one of the state's biggest secrets. Speaking together on camera for the first time, the creepy similarities between the women's experiences come to light: from the way they were seduced into their relationships, to the almost identical letters they received when they were abandoned - and ghosted - by the men they loved. They reveal how they discovered police officers stole the identities of deceased children to create new aliases and even fathered children with the women they spied upon whilst undercover.
title: The Undercover Police Scandal: Love and Lies Exposed

overview: Since childhood, Pavel was nicknamed the Chess Player - both for his passion for a noble game, and for his ability to think extraordinary, build intricate combinations, and calculate opponent's moves. All this came in handy for the Chess Player in the troubled fate that the profession of a military intelligence officer imposed on him, and the circumstances of life after leaving for a "civilian". It is not in Paul's character to indulge in the charms of civil life while there are offended people in the world.
title: Шахматист

overview: Cape Carnage: Killer Catch follows the Davey family, led by Captain Bruce, his wife, Juanita, and son Tiger, as they make their living in one of the most dangerous ways possible - hand line fishing in the treacherous waters of the Gulf of Carpentaria, also infamously known as Cape Carnage, off the northern coast of Australia. The Gulf of Carpentaria is bustling with life; crocodile, tuna, and the apex predator - shark. From July to October, fishermen from all over Australia gather here to hunt for one fish in particular - the lucrative Spanish mackerel, and with some of the most sought-after flesh in the world, these are a million dollar catch worth fighting for. Captain Bruce and his family have been fishing these waters for more than half a century, and Tiger and his wife Prue are holding with family tradition by raising their two young children aboard the family boat, M. V. Wildcard. For the four months of the year when the prized Spanish mackerel are running, these seas and the Wildcard are their home, and they take on nature by hand, battling the weather, the sharks, and sometimes themselves, as they chase their fortune. Over ten episodes, as they face challenges at every turn, Cape Carnage: Killer Catch charts the blood, sweat and tears of the Davey family and crew through another turbulent fishing season and family life on board M. V. Wildcard.
title: Cape Carnage: Killer Catch

overview: Off the Grid takes the fans off the track and into the sights and sounds of the culture that surrounds motorsports.
title: Off the Grid

overview: Talay, a young sergeant who has a stigma from her childhood, becomes in charge of a murder case of Tanpol, a well-off young psychologist who is suspected of killing his wife, Piangchan. As she went deeper into this case, she found many irregularities including secrets and love relations as well as threats from the anonymous murderer between those involved in this case including Talay herself.
title: Luang Kah Lah Ruk

overview: The Repair Shop experts are off on a road trip across the UK fixing historical treasures and precious objects that can't be brought to the barn.
title: The Repair Shop on the Road

overview: Ten candidates are left separately in the Canadian wilderness and have to survive alone. The last one standing wins 75,000 euros. Who can last the longest?
title: Alone - Überlebe die Wildnis

overview: On March 24, 2015, Germanwings Flight 9525 crashed in the French Alps. All 150 passengers and crew members died. After just 48 hours, the French public prosecutor's office was certain that co-pilot Andreas Lubitz deliberately caused the plane to crash. Germanwings - Was geschah an Bord von Flug 9525? takes a meticulous look at the event and makes it clear that ten years after the crash, many questions remain unanswered - for example, relatives and aviation accident experts have identified inconsistencies that make them doubt the narrative of the French authorities. In three episodes, relatives of the victims and their lawyer Elmar Giemulla as well as journalists and other experts have their say. Aviation safety expert Simon Hradecky is also accompanied in a detailed reconstruction of the last minutes of the flight.
title: Germanwings – Was geschah an Bord von Flug 9525?

overview: Famous musicians, actors and actresses, bloggers, athletes, and not only are interviewed at Kinopoisk, but they also brilliantly (or not) solve difficult work tasks.
title: Дежурный по Кинопоиску

overview: The series revolves around a family reunion years in the making. What begins as a joyous family dinner for the siblings turns into a night of unexpected confrontations, leading to a conclusion no one could foresee. After that night, nothing in their lives will ever be the same.
title: Kardelenler

overview: VH1 will bring its entire 2015 You Oughta Know class of artists together on one stage for an unforgettable night of music to perform at VH1's Big Music In 2015: You Oughta Know event from The Armory Foundation in New York City on Thursday, November 12 at 9/8C. The VH1 Big Music In 2015: You Oughta Know artists taking the stage include Hozier, Ella Henderson, George Ezra, Tori Kelly, James Bay, Nate Ruess, Rachel Platten, Elle King, Miguel and X Ambassadors. This festival-style concert event will feature performances by each of the You Oughta Know artists, including never-before-seen collaborations and covers. Viewers will also get an inside look at the artists' personal lives and careers through VH1 original short film profiles that will showcase exactly what and why 'You Oughta Know' about each of the performers. The VH1 You Oughta Know franchise has helped jumpstart and break the careers of some of music's biggest names including: Adele, Ed Sheeran, Lorde, Mumford & Sons, Sam Smith and Sia and many, many more. In addition to selling millions of records and going platinum many times over, VH1 You Oughta Know alums go on to win not just Grammys, but also Golden Globes and even Academy Awards.
title: You Oughta Know Live in Concert

overview: In Holmes on Homes: Building a Legacy, Mike Holmes joins forces with his children, Michael and Sherry, as they continue his legacy – helping homeowners in need. From renovations gone wrong by crooked or incompetent contractors to bad DIY, to worthy homeowners in need of a life-changing renovation, the Holmes trio continues the work that made Mike a household name. They go behind the walls and above code to focus on safe, functional, efficient, and healthy homes. They do this while promoting a career in the skilled trades. Each project is more than just a renovation, it's an opportunity to help make people's lives better.
title: Holmes on Homes: Building a Legacy

overview: Daon, a smart and handsome salary man, often clashes with his colleague Sunghyeon. Their relationship becomes more and more ambiguous as time progresses, while other figures like Jaemin, a former tutor, and heir to the company Suhyeon make their way into his life. What shape will this love square end up turning into?
title: Secret Relationships

overview: An intimate glimpse into the lives of three families with a loved one on the autism spectrum as they embark on a journey of understanding.
title: Traveling The Spectrum

overview: My Pet Ate What? showcases real-life stories of pet owners grappling with the questionable digestive choices. Each episode features hilarious and suspenseful tales; from a Bernese Mountain Dog with a taste for intimate apparel; to the nail-biting suspense of a cat sampling "shiny treats" from their owner's wallet, and everything in between. With more than 20 years of veterinary experience, Dr. G is one of the world's only full-time travelling animal endoscopists. Each week, Dr. G handles more than a dozen non-surgical cases, using endoscopy to locate and retrieve swallowed objects, and the outcome can range from humorous retrieval to delivering difficult diagnoses. Aiding with the workload is Dr. G's son Ben who provides pet owners with comfort, shares the news of successful removals, and at times does a little detective work to identify mysterious finds. Together, this dynamic father-son duo combines old-school skills and fresh enthusiasm to every case.
title: My Pet Ate What?

overview: The Five Star Weekend is centered on Hollis Shaw, a famed cook and best-selling author known for her delicious recipes, impeccable taste, and warm demeanor, who suffers a devastating loss. Unable to move forward, the death starts to expose the cracks in Hollis's picture-perfect life - her strained marriage, her complicated relationship with her daughter, and her growing pursuit of validation from her fans. In an effort to overcome grief and find herself again, Hollis gets the idea to host a weekend away at her house on Nantucket with three friends from different stages in her life: her childhood, her twenties, thirties, and one surprise fifth star. Set against a luxurious and coastal backdrop, the stars will mature in ways they could never imagine as boundaries are pushed and secrets are exposed.
title: The Five Star Weekend

overview: Celebrating the economic impact Taylor Swift's brand has on and off-stage; exploring how she has redefined business landscapes in music, fashion, sports, education and philanthropy, generating billions of dollars and influencing global markets.
title: The Swift Effect

overview: An intimate drama series about a group of lesbian friends struggling with romance and careers in Los Angeles.
title: The L Word

overview: The Yarns tells the story of a serial killer who leaves no traces, only strange knitted yarns placed on the victims. Inspector Pilanthorn partners with Sky, an autistic woman with an extraordinary ability to decode complex patterns, to uncover the meaning behind the yarns and stop the killer before the next murder takes place.
title: Pritsana Pom Mai

overview: This is the story of the tumultuous Silakhram household of Khun Luang Prasit who has five wives: first wife Phailin who has beloved daughter Kaewta; secondary wife Duean; Pim; Im who has cherished son Sin; and former servant Phum who has stepson Kuea.
title: Ruean Chon Saeng

overview: Yotsaran is sent to save his family's failing resort only to find a Khao Soi shop blocking the entrance. He clashes with Bang-Earn, the sharp-tongued owner who refuses to back down. As they fight to protect their businesses, their rivalry slowly turns into an unexpected romance. It is a story of a city boy and a feisty local girl finding love through a perfect bowl of noodles.
title: Love @Fifty First Bite

overview: Three individuals, each with unique birth fortunes, become bound by a shared destiny to thwart death and protect many lives. Guided by the prophecies of an old monk, the trio uncovers their intertwined fate and embarks on a critical mission. Together, they confront a formidable enemy destined to unleash catastrophe, racing against time to avert the impending disaster.
title: Zodiac Slayer

overview: An alien explorer crash-lands in the rural village of Don Muang and disguises himself as a local man named Bak Der. While trying to blend in, he falls in love with Bak Der's wife, Saiphin, and learns what it truly means to be human. As his departure date approaches, M29 must decide whether to return to his galaxy or stay and live a simple life with the woman who captured his heart.
title: Love You 10 Million Miles

overview: Midway through the 2023/24 season, Jürgen Klopp stuns Liverpool fans by announcing his departure. This series charts his final season and nine year tenure, showing how he turned doubters into believers and led the club to Premier League and Champions League glory. With exclusive interviews, we explore his coaching evolution, trust in young talent, and the reasons behind his emotional farewell.
title: Doubters to Believers Liverpool FC: Klopp's Era

overview: In a crumbling empire, a royal marriage could unite warring kingdoms. When a mysterious sorceress forces a peasant girl into competing for the heir's hand, she must balance survival, romance, and the fate of the realm.
title: Rise of the Empress

overview: Kaew and Penporn's parents were killed by a bad guy when they were little. After Kaew's escape, she was trained as a fighter by a close friend of her father. After growing up, Kaew returns to her village disguised as a man, wearing a red mask and becomes Nang Singh while she sets out to take revenge against the wrong doers. Thummo is a police officer sent on a mission to kaew's village. He is in charge of arresting Nang Singh and becomes a friend of Kaew in the meanwhile. What's more, Kaew finds herself falling in love with Thummo.
title: Nang Singh Sabad Chor

overview: Khor, a young man who does not believe in supernatural matters and does not believe in "Sleeping Godfather", sacred things that the villagers respect. He reject these beliefs until there was an event that caused him to lose his only son. People say that was because he does not respect the godfather.
title: Ngu x Khon Song Chao

overview: Rawi, a wealthy and arrogant prince, has no choice but to marry Phetphring. Refusing any physical relationship with her, she seeks intimacy outside the home and becomes pregnant. When Rawi learns of it, she's divorced and driven out of the palace. Phetphring isn't going to say goodbye to her luxurious lifestyle so easily, however, and she and her lover Mesa devise a plan to kill Rawi. When the fight comes to pass, Rawi grabs Mesa's necklace before falling into an abyss. He wakes up in a village under the care of Lukjan. Because he has amnesia, Lukjan names him Tawan.
title: Heman Tawan Ron

overview: Caso Cerrado: Edición Estelar (Case Closed: Star Edition) is a show that airs in primetime and is made in high definition, born of the popular afternoon slot the "Case Closed", which has been on TV for a long time. The show has an innovative scenario, which is used as a tried and covers broad themes. Dra. Polo is responsible for dealing with legal cases of different nature that affect the Hispanic population. Thanks to their righteousness, sense of equality, wisdom and years of experience in the legal branch, Dr. Polo delivers a final verdict with equanimity to real cases that are brought before it. Before the verdict, counsel attentive listening to the parties and witnesses performs the relevant questions to the subject matter it is benevolent but has strong hand and always finds a way to deliver justice in the program.
title: Caso Cerrado: Edición Estelar

overview: Detective captain Chen Xi solves a baffling case where five teens vanish mysteriously. Her investigation uncovers intricate conflicts and hidden ties among their families, revealing a web of secrets.
title: 5 Missing Teenagers

overview: Eighteen-year-old Xia Xia was admitted to the Law School of Nanjing University with excellent grades, but her stepfather was not prepared to support her to go to college. In order to go to school, she had to pretend to her stepfather that she left home to work and make money. After entering the school, in addition to studying every day, she was busy with part-time work and met Xie Huai, a classmate who also worked part-time outside the school to make money. Because of misunderstandings, the two did not like each other, but with Xia Xia's active approach, they gradually became familiar with each other and became partners. Xia Xia gradually understood Xie Huai's past. He avoided his studies because of his inner trauma, and worked to make money to treat his mother's illness. Xia Xia helped Xie Huai regain his ideals and face his studies. The two also gradually developed feelings in mutual help and healing. As Xie Huai was about to graduate from university, his mother had to go abroad for treatment due to worsening illness, and had to separate from Xia Xia.
title: The Great Dreamer

overview: How I Escaped My Cult is a riveting true crime series that takes viewers into insidious modern-day cults through the unique lens of members who endured unspeakable trauma and the shocking investigations into these oppressive groups. With detailed, firsthand accounts from former cult members, their loved ones, and the investigators who helped bring these tormentors to justice, each episode follows the unique and harrowing journey of a survivor from their earliest cult experiences and revelations all the way up to their heart-pounding escapes.
title: How I Escaped My Cult

overview: More than 100 years ago, Sacadura Cabral and Gago Coutinho revolutionized air navigation technology by making the first South Atlantic connection between March 30 and June 17, 1922, connecting Lisbon to Rio de Janeiro. We follow Portuguese aviation pioneers Gago Coutinho and Sacadura Cabral in their fearless race to cross the South Atlantic, driven by a strong spirit of adventure, challenging the limits of human endeavour as they navigated unknown skies. His scientific achievements and innovations in astronomical navigation revealed the way to other planets in the universe.
title: A Travessia

overview: Richard Whitehead MBE and Adele Roberts embark on a powerful journey to transform sport, breaking down barriers for under-represented communities as they create the most inclusive running event ever. Through personal stories and inspiring encounters with fearless individuals who dare to defy their own sporting expectations, they reveal a bold new vision of what it truly means to belong in sport.
title: Dare to Defy

overview: How did the Soviet Union impose its communist ideology on central and eastern Europe after the Second World War? From 1945 until the building of the Berlin Wall in 1961, citizens of central and eastern Europe tell their stories of how their countries were occupied and transformed into communist states.
title: Rideau de fer - L'occupation soviétique

overview: Highlights of The Australian Open Water Championships from Busselton, WA.
title: Australian Open Water Championships

overview: After a sheriff's deputy found a woman zip-tied and frantic on the side of the road in the Mojave Desert in 2012, authorities discovered this may have been a grisly crime in pursuit of a suspected buried treasure. This discovery kicked off a years-long investigation that spanned sting operations, an international search, a prison break captured on cellphone, and a courtroom showdown between lead prosecutor Matt Murphy and the man authorities believed was pulling the strings in a twisted game of greed and violence — Hossein Nayeri. Set during the early days of medical marijuana, Wicked Game: Devil in the Desert is a gripping three-part docuseries told through intimate access inside the case and to those who lived the story unlike any other. The docuseries showcases rare evidence stills, body cam and dash cam videos of gripping key moments, recorded police interviews with the victims and suspects, and features new interviews with the lead prosecutor and deputy counsel and the lead detective on the case. The series also incorporates "20/20"'s groundbreaking past reporting on the case, including archival interviews with victims and Nayeri, the so-called mastermind himself.
title: Wicked Game: The Devil in the Desert

overview: In the wealthy suburbs of Indianapolis, husband and father of three Herb Baumeister led a double life — businessman by day, serial killer by night. Throughout the 1990s, he targeted gay men, amassing a victim count possibly surpassing that of Jeffrey Dahmer. The Fox Hollow Murders: Playground of a Serial Killer is a four-part series that follows Hamilton County coroner Jeff Jellison as he launches a new investigation decades after thousands of bones were found in the woods behind Fox Hollow Farms, Baumeister's stately home. Using new DNA technology, Jellison and his team work to identify the human remains, bringing long-deferred closure to victims' families and unearthing unsettling questions about potential accomplices, missing evidence, and a key witness whose story keeps changing. Through never-before-seen archival footage and new interviews with those central to the story, this new docuseries explores how the murders went undetected. In an exclusive interview, a Baumeister survivor, Mark Goodyear, emerges from the shadows, revealing his face for the first time in an on-camera interview, raising more questions about his relationship with the man he says wanted to kill him. Additional interviews include investigators involved in the original case and new investigation, relatives of Baumeister's victims, the current owner of Fox Hollow Farm, and the cold case experts working to bring closure for families still waiting for answers.
title: The Fox Hollow Murders: Playground of a Serial Killer

overview: ITV has commissioned The Hack, a 7-part ITV Studios co-production with Stan, Australia about the phone hacking scandal written by BAFTA, Tony and Olivier award winning screenwriter, Jack Thorne, with David Tennant, Robert Carlyle and Toby Jones in leading roles and produced by the team from Mr Bates vs The Post Office. Set between 2002 and 2012, the drama deftly interweaves two real life stories, the work of investigative journalist Nick Davies, played by David Tennant, who uncovered evidence of phone hacking at the News of the World, and running parallel, the story of the investigation into the unsolved murder of private investigator Daniel Morgan, led by former Met Police Detective Chief Superintendent Dave Cook, played by Robert Carlyle. Toby Jones plays former Editor-in Chief of The Guardian, Alan Rusbridger.
title: The Hack

overview: Optics follows two whip-smart 20-something women who are unexpectedly promoted to run crisis management PR firm Fritz & Randell, after the death of office patriarch Frank Fritz. As they battle weekly public relations crises from celebrities, sports stars and corporate titans, and power challenges from veteran PR flack Ian Randell, they slowly come to realise that their firm might have a scandal brewing of its own, and start to wonder: have they been set up to fail?
title: Optics
